🔥 Shelter-Humanizer | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Improving and cleaning text content using AI, with a focus on local LLM processing for privacy and offline use.
✨ Key Features: • AI-assisted text rewriting and style improvement • Local LLM support (Ollama, DeepSeek, Qwen) • Unicode cleanup and character checking • Text comparison and change tracking • Preservation of numbers, quotes, links, and selected terms
📖 Summary: Shelter Humanizer is a Windows-based AI-assisted text editor that enhances writing by removing clichés, improving phrasing, and cleaning up Unicode characters. It supports local LLM integration for offline processing and offers features for style analysis and comparison.
